user.title: YongKeHui

house.title: Select House
house.description: Select the house/community to expose to Home Assistant.

error.captcha_missing: Enter the image captcha, or enable Refresh captcha.

error.no_locks_found: Login succeeded, but no usable locks were found.

abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again and reloaded the integration.
abort.reauth_house_not_found: Login succeeded, but this account can no longer access the configured house/community. Check house permissions in YongKeHui before retrying authentication.
